landscapes.name: Omo-Gibe Basin
landscapes.credit: Contains data from 'Ethiopia River Basins', World Bank Group (World Bank Data Catalog, dataset 0040202), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Changes: Omo basin polygon extracted, reprojected from Adindan / UTM zone 37N to WGS 84 and trimmed near the Kenya border (about 255 km2).

landscapes.name: Central India Highlands
landscapes.credit: District boundaries: GADM (gadm.org) and Survey of India.

landscapes.name: Pucallpa – Ucayali
landscapes.credit: Contains referential census district limits of the Instituto Nacional de Estadistica e Informatica (INEI), Peru (ide.inei.gob.pe); the limits are referential and have no demarcation value. Changes: districts dissolved into one outline and Calleria clipped. No licence is stated by INEI (to be confirmed).
landscapes.note: Delineation pending confirmation with the Peru team.

landscapes.name: Northwestern Tunisia
landscapes.credit: Contains data from 'Tunisia - Subnational Administrative Boundaries' (COD-AB), source: Institut National de la Statistique Tunisie (INS), published by UN OCHA on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-tun), licensed under CC BY-IGO 3.0. Changes: seven admin-4 sectors dissolved into one outline.
